titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Only roles whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive), e.g. "data engineer", "nurse".

titleExcludeKeywords.title: Exclude title keywords
titleExcludeKeywords.description: Drop roles whose title contains any of these, e.g. "intern", "senior".

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Only roles where any listed location (or the country) contains one of these, e.g. "Texas", "London", "Germany". Multi-location roles match on every location.

companyKeywords.title: Companies
companyKeywords.description: Only these companies — matches the company name or its career-site id, e.g. "Morgan Stanley", "stripe".

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only roles posted in the last N days. Roles without a posting date count from the day our index first saw them.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only jobs new since this search last ran
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: For scheduled runs: return only jobs the index has added since this same search last ran, so you never pay for the same job twice. The first run returns all current matches. The Actor remembers each search in a key-value store named career-site-jobs-monitor in your account; changing any filter starts a new history.

monitorName.title: Search name (optional)
monitorName.description: Only needed to keep two searches with identical filters separate, e.g. one per client.

remoteOnly.title: Remote roles only
remoteOnly.description: Only roles whose location or workplace label says remote.

onlyWithSalary.title: Only jobs that state pay
onlyWithSalary.description: Only roles whose posting states a pay range or rate. About a quarter of all roles do; in the US, pay-transparency laws make it far more common.

minAnnualSalary.title: Minimum yearly pay
minAnnualSalary.description: Only roles whose pay range reaches at least this much per year, in the job's own currency. Hourly and monthly pay are converted (hour × 2,080, month × 12). Implies 'only jobs that state pay'.

salaryCurrencies.title: Pay currencies
salaryCurrencies.description: Only roles paying in these currencies, e.g. "USD", "GBP", "EUR". Implies 'only jobs that state pay'.

sources.title: Career-site systems
sources.description: Limit to some systems. Leave empty for all.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Turn off for a smaller, faster dataset with titles, locations and links only.

maxJobs.title: Maximum jobs
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on results, and your main cost control — you are charged per job returned. Newest roles come first.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Maximum jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Optional cap per company, so one big employer does not fill the whole result.
